title: SE implementation scratchpad - Midtown Trust
content:
Quick scratchpad for Midtown Trust SE implementation (private deployment). Informal notes, config ideas, action items.

Context:
- Customer: Midtown Trust (regional bank, regulatory constraints).
- Engagement: Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed network).
- Primary ask: Host LLM-based document summarization and intelligent search behind bank firewall; strict KMS/HSM requirement and audit logs.
- SLA targets discussed: p95 < 250ms for short (<=256 tokens) completions, throughput target ~300 reqs/min steady, spike to 800/min during batch ingest windows.

Meeting notes (2026-02-24 with PM + infra):
- They will provide 2 subnets for Redwood control plane peering (app + data). Need CIDR ranges and route table details.
- KMS: customer uses AWS KMS with external key policy -> require KMS role mapping and egress rules.
- Compliance: enable audit-level logs to S3 (retention 7 years) + SIEM forwarding.
- Data flow: Documents never leave VPC; only telemetry allowed to Redwood control plane over approved egress.

Config / Implementation checklist (initial):
- [ ] VPC peering: confirm peering id + route tables (owner: Lina) due 2026-02-28
- [ ] KMS access: create cross-account IAM role / test encrypt/decrypt (owner: Priya) due 2026-03-03
- [ ] Model pinning: propose Llama-2-70B (quantized) + fallback to 13B for cost spikes (owner: Avery) due 2026-03-02
- [ ] Autoscaling policy: min capacity 2 instances (8xA10G equiv), burst to 6 instances during ingest windows; set cooldown 300s (owner: Diego) due 2026-03-04
- [ ] Logging: ensure CloudTrail + S3 bucket + SIEM ingestion (owner: Lina) due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Eval set: collect 50 representative prompts and outputs for regression monitoring (owner: Priya) due 2026-03-06

Notes on model/quantization strategy:
- Recommend Q4_K_M (or int8) path to hit cost/latency targets. For p95 <250ms on <=256 tokens we should:
  - use dedicated GPU pool with persistent KV cache warmers for frequent prefixes (customer will have a handful of templates).
  - enable continuous batching with max batch size 16, dynamic batching by request latency to avoid head-of-line; target avg batch 4-6.
  - set token limit 512, but prefer 256 default for summaries.

Routing/rollout plan:
- Canary: route 5% of traffic to new model variant (quantized 70B) for 48h, compare latency/cost/quality.
- Fallback: automatic fallback to 13B when queue depth > X or p95 latency > 400ms for 5m.
- Metrics: token_cost_per_minute, p95_latency, error_rate, model_quality_score (from eval set).

Network / security details to confirm with customer:
- Egress allowed to redwood-control.example.com on ports 443 only, and to S3 endpoints for audit logs.
- Do they require TLS mutual auth for control-plane? They said yes in call -> add mTLS cert exchange step.
- HSM: they will provide HSM in-custodial flow; need to map keys into Redwood KMS integration.

Integration TODOs / small tests:
- Spin up a private deployment in staging with a mirror of their subnet (local test VPC). Quick test steps:
  1) Validate peering + route table propagation.
  2) Validate KMS encrypt/decrypt with cross-account role.
  3) Deploy a minimal model (13B quantized) and run synthetic load to verify p95 latency baseline.

Action items (short-term):
- Avery: draft model pin + canary config and expected cost delta (2026-03-02). Links: infra PR template -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412
- Lina: send VPC peering request template and ask for route table screenshots (2026-02-28).
- Priya: KMS role proof-of-concept; will request sample ARN and run via CI (2026-03-03).
- Diego: propose autoscaling thresholds + expected GPU types (A10G / H100 equivalents) (2026-03-04).

Open questions / risks:
- If HSM integration not possible in timeline, fallback is Redwood-managed KMS with customer-approved key export policy -> needs legal approval (raise with legal).
- Data residency: confirm whether logs may be stored in multi-region S3 or must be single-region.
- Throughput risk: if customer ingest windows exceed 1200 req/min, need temporary dedicated burst nodes. Estimate cost impact and include in proposal.

Scratch ideas (brainstorm):
- Precompute embeddings for archive docs and surface vector search via read-only index in their VPC to reduce live token costs.
- Warm KV cache with nightly job for top 100 templates to reduce cold-start latency.
- Consider lighter-weight reranker (13B) for initial search candidate scoring, then call 70B for final summarization only.

Notes-to-self: keep this doc informal — move finalized configs to Confluence page MT-125 and infra PR once agreed.

Recent edits: 2026-03-01 added autoscaling thresholds; 2026-02-27 initial notes from kickoff.

Links / refs: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/MT-125-integration-plan | Jira: JIRA-SE-1024 | Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

End of scratchpad.
